landmarks.label: Moonstone Fountain
landmarks.detail: Moonstones brought home shine above a quiet garden pool.

landmarks.label: Homeward Obelisk
landmarks.detail: A faceted moonstone needle marks the journey between two homes.

landmarks.label: Lunar Crystal Pavilion
landmarks.detail: A crystal-roofed pavilion shelters moonstones brought back to the valley.

landmarks.label: Moonstone Henge
landmarks.detail: An open circle of lunar rock, crowned with luminous moonstones.

landmarks.label: Earthlight Spire
landmarks.detail: A split crystal spire catches Earthlight above a court of moon rock.

landmarks.label: Crater Amphitheatre
landmarks.detail: Curving moon-rock terraces gather around a moonstone stage.

landmarks.label: Prospectors’ Headframe
landmarks.detail: A timber headframe and winding wheel above a cart of the first crystals.

landmarks.label: Wind Garden
landmarks.detail: A many-bladed windpump lifting water for the first farm gardens.

landmarks.label: Founders’ Longhall
landmarks.detail: Twin gables, deep porches and a welcoming courtyard.

landmarks.label: Founders’ Arch
landmarks.detail: A monumental stone gateway and bronze sun.

landmarks.label: Crystal Spire
landmarks.detail: A soaring cluster of violet and turquoise crystals.

landmarks.label: Guardian of the Hollow
landmarks.detail: A great bronze owl watching over the town.

landmarks.label: World Tree
landmarks.detail: A sculpted copper tree on a ring of pale stone.

landmarks.label: Celestial Sphere
landmarks.detail: Golden orbital rings suspended above a star court.

landmarks.label: Sunburst Filling Station
landmarks.detail: Art Deco pumps beneath a canopy crowned with a golden sunburst.

landmarks.label: Chrome Diner
landmarks.detail: A streamlined roadside diner with chrome bands and a tall neon pylon.

landmarks.label: Terminus Clock
landmarks.detail: A stepped Art Deco clock tower where the first bus line turns for home.

landmarks.label: Music Shell
landmarks.detail: A fan-shaped concert shell and broad audience terraces.

landmarks.label: Big Screen
landmarks.detail: A giant outdoor television in colour, flanked by speaker stacks.

landmarks.label: Signal Spire
landmarks.detail: An open lattice broadcast mast crowned with signal rings.

landmarks.label: Orbit House
landmarks.detail: A solar dome with a slender telescope above its colonnade.

landmarks.label: Solar Crown
landmarks.detail: A slender tower opening a wide crown of solar petals over a garden ring.

landmarks.label: Maglev Loop
landmarks.detail: A glowing test loop where a quiet maglev pod is on show.

landmarks.label: Warm Spring Terraces
landmarks.detail: Round pools of warm spring water stepping down between lanterns.

landmarks.label: Garden of Light
landmarks.detail: Lavender crystal-glass domes that gather daylight over a winter garden.

landmarks.label: Lotus Pavilion
landmarks.detail: Pearl petal roofs on slender columns, hung with amber lanterns.

landmarks.label: Orrery Garden
landmarks.detail: A ring of hedges where brass planets circle a golden sun.

landmarks.label: Comet Arch
landmarks.detail: A slender arch with a comet and its starry tail streaming over the lawn.

landmarks.label: Aurora Dome
landmarks.detail: A glass dome under ribbons of aurora light.

landmarks.label: First Footprints
landmarks.detail: The first boot prints and a settlers’ flag preserved beneath a crystal-glass dome.

landmarks.label: Earthrise Arch
landmarks.detail: A regolith arch tipped with moonstone crystals, framing the Earth above the crater.

landmarks.label: Orbital Beacon
landmarks.detail: Slowly turning orbital rings carry a bright beacon for the two Hollows.

landmarks.label: Twin-lantern Walk
landmarks.detail: An avenue of twin lanterns, one for the valley and one for the Moon.

landmarks.label: Earth and Moon Garden
landmarks.detail: A fountain garden where a little Earth and Moon share one pool.

landmarks.label: Family Welcome Arch
landmarks.detail: A homecoming arch with banners and a bench for waiting families.

landmarks.label: Earthlight Orchard
landmarks.detail: Fruit trees under glass, tended by the Willowkin. It feeds New Hollow and gives them a home from home.

landmarks.label: Crystal Nursery
landmarks.detail: Moonstone crystals grown under a lattice roof, with prospectors studying every new facet.

landmarks.label: Earthlight Bakehouse
landmarks.detail: A round bakehouse and its warm dining dome, where the whole crater gathers for pie.
